title: Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the resignation of board member Ivy Brown on April 20, 2026, for personal reasons. The resignation is not due to any disagreement with company operations, policies, or practices. Her seat will remain vacant pending identification of a new director or a board size reduction.
key_points: Ivy Brown resigned from the Board of Directors effective April 20, 2026
Resignation was for personal reasons, not due to any disagreement with the company
Ms. Brown will not stand for reelection at the May 8, 2026 annual meeting
The company does not plan to introduce a substitute nominee at the annual meeting
The board seat will remain vacant until a new director is identified or board size is reduced
The filing was signed by Alexandros Aldous, General Counsel, on April 24, 2026
